## Summary

Elmhurst Clinics LLP (policy CC-1666): fire damage in a neighbouring unit to a label printer and a barcode scanner at a storage unit on Mill Road. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 3,254 dollars.

## Facts

Elmhurst Clinics LLP reported the loss on 21 June 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a storage unit on Mill Road [notice of loss]. The cause was fire damage in a neighbouring unit [notice of loss], [incident report]. The items are a label printer and a barcode scanner [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 23 June 2026 under reference IR/2026/4234 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The label printer is invoiced at 1,666 dollars and the barcode scanner at 1,588 dollars [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The file contains no policy schedule, so it does not show the named premises or any excess [policy].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the named premises, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, when caused by theft, fire, storm or escape of water [policy]. Fire is an insured cause under that clause [policy]. The file does not state the basis on which the insured held the storage unit, so custody should be confirmed against the schedule before payment.

- Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it concerns theft of unattended portable equipment, and no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: it concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is attributed to a fire [notice of loss], [policy].
- Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and none is [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy].

Clauses 4.5 (transit), 4.7 (escape of water) and 4.9 (electrical surge) do not apply to the cause reported [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming custody of the storage unit against the policy schedule.

## Reserve

The reserve is 3,254 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (1,666 dollars and 1,588 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the file, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none [policy].
